mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER ( USER_ID, USER_PW, USER_NM, USER_TEL, LAST_DT, JOIN_DT, SAFETY_SCORE, SAFETY_GR, BLACK_YN ) VALUES ( #{USER_ID}, #{USER_PW}, #{USER_NM}, #{USER_TEL}, NULL, SYSDATE, 100, 1, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, USER_PW, USER_NM, USER_TEL, LAST_DT, JOIN_DT, SAFETY_SCORE, SAFETY_GR, BLACK_YN FROM TB_USER WHERE TRIM(USER_ID) = TRIM(#{USER_ID}) AND TRIM(USER_PW) = TRIM(#{USER_PW})
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NM, USER_TEL, JOIN_DT, LAST_DT, SAFETY_SCORE, SAFETY_GR, BLACK_YN FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
